# ProveSource Alternative

Who May Find Cue to be a More Suitable ProveSource Alternative?

At Cue, we know how hard it is to be a new player on the market and how much effort it takes to build clientele and brand credibility from scratch. This is why we built our highly-affordable and easy-to-use social proof tool that can quickly help you expand your user base. 

Both Cue and ProveSource are very affordable, user-friendly and feature-packed social proof tools that can cater to a wide range of industries and businesses. However, there are certain aspects and traits each of these apps provides that can better suit specific types of users and therefore be a more potent social proof solution. [...] Although ProveSource offers a greater number of integrations, Cue manages to remedy this kind of competitor’s advantage by providing its users an option to fully customize the data shown in their notifications. This makes Cue a better ProveSource alternative for those looking for a one-size-fits-all social proof tool regardless of their niche or company size. [...] When it comes to free trials, both Cue and ProveSource offer it, but ProveSource limits the number of unique visitors to 1k visits. As Cue is a freemium tool, our users can continue to deploy our app for free even when their trial period expires. Basically, Cue available to our users forever – without any credit card information required!

### Features

Though ProveSource has a certain advantage when it comes to data sources – with other features and setting options being quite similar between the two tools –  we recommend Cue as a better ProveSource alternative to those who seek the highest customizability levels a social proof tool is able to offer. 

This is why our main edge in terms of features is: 

→ Full Data Customization
